Kate, I’ll accept 17 tons each this month if all five explicitly agree, along with your fallback caps of 5 each at a stock of 30 and 1 each at a stock of 10. Those limits preserve the minimum stock even if we repeatedly miss the external replenishment.

My commitment is conditional on unanimous agreement—not permission to catch 17 regardless of what others decide. We should confirm the starting stock and everyone’s cap before fishing each month, then review the revealed catches afterward.

John, you haven’t weighed in yet. Would you accept this package, or do you prefer a lower catch to protect future income? Luke and Emma would also need to confirm the change from 18 to 17.
